points.description: Data rate must not exceed the channel capacity (output/compressed data rate must be within the communication channel's capacity).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely refers to bandwidth/rate limits without relating to channel capacity.

points.description: Full capacity of the communication channel should be utilized (no wasted channel capacity).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says channel should be used efficiently, without full utilization idea.

points.description: Maximum quality (of the data/reconstructed image) should be preserved.
points.partial_credit: Half if mentions quality or fidelity loss vaguely without maximizing/preserving it.

rubric.notes: Three issues, each worth about one third of the total; clear synonyms are accepted. Total is rounded to 2 for all three, 1 for roughly one or two correct, 0 for none. Unrelated points (e.g. cost, power) earn nothing but do not remove marks for correct points.
